$description: Vibes: one choice that sets a style, a brand colour, a scheme and the dials, modelled on how well-known apps feel. Names are our own; `like` says which app the vibe evokes. brand: a hex (used exactly for filled buttons, tuned for AA when used as text) or a preset name; on: the text colour the app puts on its brand colour (white | black), kept unless AA needs the other. scheme: the scheme the app is known for (light | dark | system). corners, density and font override the style. scripts/vibes.mjs resolves the colours and fails the build if any pair drops below 4.5:1.
